claims.claim: Cleanly used Electric bike for sale
claims.evidence: Exhaust pipe visible on the left side; witness identifies a motor scooter, not an electric bike.
Exhaust pipe indicates internal combustion; no battery is shown in the report.
No purchase date, receipt, or age indicators appear in the photos.
Still photos show a disc brake but cannot confirm gear operation or brake performance.
The report does not mention rust; a watermark crosses the lower image area where rust might be visible.
Part originality cannot be determined from the photos.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting and idling
Photo of the odometer and original purchase or registration documents
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age and high mileage

risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread depth and sidewalls

risks.risk: Missing ownership documents or service history
risks.proof: Photos of original registration, proof of ownership, and service records
Mechanic inspection report or test-ride video

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Close-up photos of tires and lower body for rust
Photos of ownership documents and service history
Video of brakes and gears in operation
response.reason: The witness identifies a motor scooter with an exhaust pipe, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's electric claim is contradicted by the visible exhaust.
